Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, M.R. SHAH
Supreme Court Rules, 2013: Or.XLVII r.2 – Review of a judgment – Limitation – In accordance with r.2 of Or.XLVII, an application for review of a judgment has to be filed within thirty days of the date of that in sought to be reviewed – No cogent grounds were furnished for the delay between 20 and 26 months by the two parties in filing their applications for review – Review petitions were filed after the judges who delivered the judgments retired from the Court – Such practice
